build_note: The pinned PySide6 6.12.0, PySide6-Essentials 6.12.0 and shiboken6 6.12.0 linux/aarch64 wheels are installed unchanged except for one file: the wheel's prebuilt libQt6Svg.so.6 is replaced by the same QtSvg 6.12.0 release built from its pinned source tarball with clang LLVM source coverage (against a plain qtbase 6.12.0 build used only for headers and CMake packages). PySide6's QtSvg binding and the wheel's QtCore/QtGui libraries load it by soname. QT_HASH_SEED=0 fixes Qt's per-process hash seed.
api: PySide6.QtSvg.QSvgRenderer(QByteArray(local SVG bytes)); isValid(), defaultSize(), render(QPainter) into a QImage and pixelColor()
fuzz_engine: external one-file Python bridge for AFL++ and generator replay
coverage: LLVM source coverage in source-built QtSvg 6.12.0 (src/svg) reached through PySide6's QSvgRenderer binding
